name: KiWay Trace RLC / Impedance Analyzer
description: Measure routed geometry and estimate RLC and impedance against an explicit reference layer.
description_full: Follows PCB net and pad selection, traverses the routed path between endpoints, enumerates the complete parsed stackup, and reports route geometry, vias, layer changes, resistance, capacitance, inductance, and first-order impedance with the exact reference layer, dielectric height, and permittivity used.
